claims.evidence: The witness report identifies the model as 'DIRT 24' from the frame markings.
Photo 0 shows a front suspension fork and a rear coil shock.
The witness report mentions brakes but does not specify if they are disc or rim brakes.
Photo 0 shows an external gear system with a rear derailleur.
Purchase date cannot be confirmed through photos.
The witness noted that the responsiveness of brakes and smoothness of gears were not shown.
The witness noted that wear or rust on the chain and sprockets was not shown.
Originality of components cannot be verified remotely without technical documentation.

risks.risk: Brakes may be non-functional or require replacement parts.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the brakes stopping the wheels while the bike is in motion.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full brake system overhaul.

risks.risk: The gear system may be seized, bent, or skipping.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the chain moving smoothly through all gears while pedaling.

risks.risk: The chain and sprockets may be heavily rusted or worn out.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the chain and the rear gear cassette.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a new chain and cassette.

risks.risk: Tires or inner tubes may be punctured or unable to hold air.
risks.proof: A video showing the tires being firmly squeezed or the bike being ridden.
risks.if_unproven: as needing new tires and tubes.

risks.risk: The non-visible side of the frame may have structural cracks or heavy damage.
risks.proof: A photo of the opposite side of the bicycle frame.

proof_requests: Video of the gears shifting through the full range.
Video of the brakes being applied to stop the wheels.
Close-up photo of the chain and rear sprockets to check for rust.
Photo of the other side of the bike.
Close-up photo of the brakes to confirm if they are disc brakes.
response.reason: The witness has clearly identified the brand and model as a Shockwave Dirt 24, which allows for a baseline valuation at its worst-case functional condition.
